company.name: Yalla Doc
company.shortDescription: YallaDoc specialty focused patient-doctor platform allows a hassle-free access to the right doctor whenever needed.
company.description: YallaDoc platform gives a reliable updated directory of healthcare providers to conveniently choose and book doctors based on reviews, Insurance, location, and availability. YallaDoc is focused on Mom and Baby and it is starting from pediatrics specialty. The solutions that Yalladoc is offering will help cover the visibility, knowledge convenience, and trust gap that patients are currently suffering from. It will also help healthcare providers improve their efficiency in managing bookings, marketing, and patients satisfaction. The platform has also another vertical that helps patients do a virtual consultation and telemedicine through a sister app that will be integrated once the legal system of UAE supports telemedicine.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $1,089, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $152,754 to $152,754, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (+3 over 90 days) and market heat at 56 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
